overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon. With a combined following of 3,580, his content focuses heavily on computational social science, disinformation, and research tools. While LinkedIn provides the largest overall reach, Bluesky and Mastodon exhibit exceptionally high engagement rates, demonstrating a highly receptive and interactive audience of peers, researchers, and students.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, publications, and conference presentations focusing on social media manipulation and disinformation detection.
Development updates on computational analysis tools like CooRnet v2.0 and discussions surrounding research methodology.
Announcements regarding open PhD and postdoctoral researcher positions, as well as new research grants.

recommendations: Cross-promote tool releases like CooRnet on LinkedIn to leverage the larger audience base and drive higher professional adoption.
Capitalize on Bluesky's highly interactive audience by utilizing Q&As or discussion threads for new publications.
Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn with structured visual assets (e.g., paper abstracts, diagrams) to further elevate engagement rates on the largest channel.
Establish a consistent hashtag strategy across all platforms, particularly Mastodon and LinkedIn, to improve search visibility within the computational social science niche.

platformInsights.bluesky: The platform boasts the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), proving to be a highly active hub for academic discourse, particularly around paper announcements and student recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: While hosting the smallest follower base, Mastodon demonstrates strong technical engagement (4.55% avg rate) particularly suited for open-source tool updates and methodological debates.
platformInsights.linkedin: Serves as the primary channel for institutional reach and professional networking, generating the highest total volume of interactions (180) for major career milestones like grants and hiring.
